review_output: {"summary":"No BLOCKER or MAJOR issues in the supplied text. Lock order is Live → FormSubmission → admission → (Video via resolver) → version → session FOR UPDATE, then re-resolve and revalidate. That order is consistent between append and close; close only skips the Video lock. Close's relaxations match the stated contract: it skips the current-content and session-lifetime checks but still requires live admission, the same verification epoch, the same scope and an enabled, unexpired version. Replays are checked before the closed state, the final sequence N can't change, and completion is never invented. There are two possible MINOR issues (time-zone handling in the expiry checks, and auth work done before the first lock) and one NIT (202 after expiry), all low confidence because the column types and the internals of resolveVerifiedPrivateChatViewer weren't supplied.","findings":[{"file":"src/lib/live-metric-ingestion.ts","area":"Expiry predicates / time zone","severity":"MINOR","issue":"Expiry checks mix styles: admission uses `AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'`, but the version and session expiry checks compare bare `expiresAt` to clock_timestamp(). If any of these columns is timestamp(3) without a time zone, the result depends on the session TimeZone.","evidence":"`v.\"expiresAt\">clock_timestamp()`, `s.\"expiresAt\">clock_timestamp()` vs `a.\"expiresAt\"> (clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')`; `f.\"verifiedAt\"=(r.\"verifiedAt\" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')` shows the schema mixes column types.","impact":"If the DB session TimeZone isn't UTC, expired versions or sessions could be accepted, or valid ones rejected, by up to the UTC offset. That would let appends or closes slip past the lifetime limits.","recommended_fix":"Check each column's type and use one explicit pattern per type, or set `SET LOCAL TIME ZONE 'UTC'` at the start of the transaction.","required_test":"Run append and close with session TimeZone set to e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles' and versions/sessions expiring within the offset window. They must be rejected or accepted exactly as under UTC.","confidence":0.4},{"file":"src/app/api/live-metrics/[vendorId]/[liveId]/intervals/route.ts","area":"Lock ordering / authorization phases","severity":"MINOR","issue":"The authorization callback ignores `phase`. On 'resolve' it runs full viewer verification before any Live/submission/admission lock. Any row lock or write inside it inverts the documented source-first order.","evidence":"`withLockedMetricSession` calls `authorization(tx, \"resolve\")` before `SELECT ... \"Live\" ... FOR SHARE`. The route callback always calls `resolveVerifiedPrivateChatViewer(tx, ...)` and `liveViewerSession.findUnique` without checking the phase. The same applies to the close route.","impact":"If the viewer resolver touches, locks or rate-counts chat or admission rows, revocation can deadlock (40P01) against it. That shows up as spurious 503s, or as revocation waiting on metric traffic.","recommended_fix":"Make the 'resolve' phase a pure read that derives scope. Do the full credential and blacklist verification only in 'revalidate', after the locks, or show that resolveVerifiedPrivateChatViewer takes no locks and makes no writes.","required_test":"Run concurrent revocation (blacklist or admission release) against append and close in a loop. Assert no 40P01 deadlocks and that revoked viewers always get 403 after the revocation commits.","confidence":0.35},{"file":"src/lib/live-metric-close.ts","area":"Close receipt semantics","severity":"NIT","issue":"An incomplete close after the session has expired still returns 202 'pending', but append can no longer fill the missing sequences. The client can't tell a recoverable gap from a permanently unknown one.","evidence":"Close skips the `s.\"expiresAt\"` check. `planMetricClose` returns `{complete:false}` when finalSequence > lastSequence, and the route maps that to 202 whatever `session.expiresAt` is.","impact":"Clients may keep retrying appends or closes that can never succeed, wasting quota. No data is fabricated.","recommended_fix":"Add `appendOpen: now < effectiveExpiresAt` (or a terminal-unknown flag) to the receipt, and return 200 with deliveryComplete=false when the gap can't be filled.","required_test":"Do a pending close after session expiry. The receipt must show that appends are closed, and a later append must return 403.","confidence":0.5}]}
